summary: Wenatchee NF ground site, Chelan County WA: 1917 cupola cabin, 1930 L-4 cab, cab removed or destroyed in 1954 (sources differ). Listed as gone.

facts.design: First lookout a cupola cabin (1917); replaced in 1930 by a gabled L-4 cab
facts.status_note: The L-4 cab was removed or destroyed in 1954 (sources differ). No source we read describes the site today.

staffing.status: Lookout man David Hale named in 1937 newspaper items

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wenatchee National Forest

events.note: Cupola cabin, the first lookout on the summit
Gabled L-4 cab replaced the cupola cabin. A Wenatchee item of August 1930 says the material was to be sent to the peak by pack horse, about five tons in all.
David Hale named in July 1937 as the Forest Service worker at Pyramid Peak that summer; a September 1937 newspaper item about a horseback trip to the station calls him the lookout man
Register says the cab was removed in 1954; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year; the Washington Lookouts page says removed
Registered October 12, 2011, nominated by Austin Post

evidence.supports: 1917 cupola cabin; 1930 gabled L-4 cab; cab removed 1954
evidence.quote: The first lookout here was a cupola cabin built in 1917. That was replaced in 1930 with a gabled L-4 cab, which was removed in 1954.

evidence.supports: located in the Wenatchee National Forest, Chelan County
firelookout.com says the cab was destroyed in 1954 (conflicts with the register)
evidence.quote: Developed in 1917 with a cupola cabin, this gabled L-4 cab, built in 1930, was destroyed in 1954.

evidence.supports: 1930 plan: a new station to be set on the highest point of the peak
evidence.quote: A new lookout station is to be set on the highest point of this peak in the next few weeks.

evidence.supports: material about five tons, sent by pack horse
evidence.quote: in all about five tons of material are used.

evidence.supports: David Hale to work at Pyramid Peak for the Forest Service in summer 1937
evidence.quote: David Hale left Monday for Pyramid Peak, where he will work for the forest service this summer.

evidence.supports: September 1937 item on a horseback trip to the station calls David Hale the lookout man
the Washington Lookouts page labels the site Removed
the site is listed as a ground site and gone
evidence.quote: Pyramid Mountain Chelan 48.07961 -120.56788 Ground Gone FFLOS US 1142, WA 56

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Washington Lookouts page say the cab was removed in 1954; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1954. The story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: The brief has no height and none is written here. The 1930 and 1937 newspaper items reach us only through the Washington Lookouts page, which quotes the Wenatchee Daily World; the original papers were not read. The removal-versus-destruction conflict in 1954 is unresolved and could be settled from Wenatchee National Forest records or the register's nomination file. The FFLA list gives status and type only, and no source describes the site now. Access is left out because no source states it, so the brief's access 'unknown' stands.
